title: Minimize OR of Remaining Elements Using Operations
summary: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, perform at most k operations where each operation combines two adjacent elements using the bitwise AND operator.
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, perform at most k operations where each operation combines two adjacent elements using the bitwise AND operator. The goal is to minimize the bitwise OR of the remaining elements after the operations.
constraints: nums is nonempty with values below 2^30, and 0≤k<length.
One operation replaces two adjacent values by their bitwise AND; use at most k operations.
Return the minimum possible bitwise OR of the remaining segment values.
hints: Choosing whether an answer bit can be zero is a partition-feasibility question under a mask of forbidden bits.
Build forbidden bits high-to-low; greedily form the maximum number of segments whose AND clears every forbidden bit.
For each candidate mask, scan segment ANDs and cut whenever masked AND becomes zero; accept when n-segments≤k.
Extra merges can join cleared segments without restoring forbidden bits, and the maximum greedy segment count minimizes required merges, so bitwise feasibility is exact.
editorial: Extra merges can join cleared segments without restoring forbidden bits, and the maximum greedy segment count minimizes required merges, so bitwise feasibility is exact.

tests.explanation: Merging the first pair and the final pair can leave [1,3,2], whose OR is three, the minimum.
Four merges can leave segment AND values two and zero, whose OR is two.
